name: Karwendelbahn
kurzbeschreibung: Experience the breathtaking **Achensee cable car** ride up to the **Bärenkopf** at **1.844 meters**, offering a stunning panoramic view of the **Karwendelgebirge**.
beschreibung: The Karwendelbahn in Maurach is a funicular railway that connects the Achensee lake to the Erfurter Hütte. Over a length of approximately 3.6 kilometers, it covers an elevation gain of around 1,000 meters. The lower station is located at 800 meters above sea level, while the upper station sits at 1,800 meters. In summer, the railway primarily serves as an ascent aid for hikers and a starting point for tours in the Karwendel mountain range. In winter, it opens up access to the Achenkirch ski area, linking the slopes with the valley below. The ride offers stunning views of the entire Achensee and the surrounding mountain ranges. The funicular is family-friendly and provides access to the high-alpine landscape with minimal effort.
